messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: GPU capacity alarm in us-west1 — queue length spike > 5k, 90th pct latency rising, autoscaler failing to add nodes. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity 

sre-elena: oncall here, ack. Watching dashboards now.

eng-ron: seeing a lot of placement failures in the scheduler log — high fragmentation across MIG slices, many small slices can't satisfy user requests.

infra-aisha: autoscaler logs -> repeated attempts, failed with `quota_exceeded` and `no_compatible_node` errors. Cloud provider returns "limit reached" for GPU type nvidia-a100.

support-jamal: customer impact: two paying customers reporting 5xxs and timeouts, Slack thread from CSM started. Ticketing in #support-incidents.

product-liz: which customers? need CSM ping.

support-jamal: affected: acme.ai (prod) and betaapp (staging->prod traffic). Latency spiking for paid inference routes.

eng-ron: paste of placement snippet:
```
2026-04-21T12:31:02Z ERROR allocation failed: no suitable node (fragmentation_score=0.82) request:gpus=1,mig_profile=1g.5gb
2026-04-21T12:31:03Z WARN  packing: tried 14 nodes, required contiguous gpu-slice not found
```

infra-aisha: autoscaler attempted 6 scale ops in last 5m, each returned: `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: GPU quota hard limit` or `PROVISIONING_DELAY`. No new nodes created.

sre-elena: mitigation plan (live):
1) throttle non-production and low-priority tenants (run `rate-limitctl set --tier=low 10qps`).
2) evict batch/idle workloads from GPU pool (evict policy `reclaim=soft`), start repack.
3) manually repack some nodes to consolidate fragments and free full GPU units.
4) request emergency quota bump with cloud ops.

eng-ron: I can trigger repack tool to coalesce slices — command: `repackctl run --region us-west1 --target-free-gpus 6 --dry-run=false`

infra-aisha: kicking off repack now. ETA ~3m. Starting with pool-gpu-1.

deploy-bot: Repack job started by infra-aisha at 6329990018 — job id repack-6329990018 (status: running).

eng-runtime: note — repack will drain pods; we'll route affected requests to fallback small-model endpoints, expect brief 10-20s tail latency.

support-jamal: please tag affected customers for SLA impact and create INC ticket. I'm preparing comms.

sre-elena: created incident INC-2026-45, added severity P1, pages sent to oncall-2 in 30m for handoff.

eng-ron: also flipping scheduler flag to reduce aggressive split policy: `schedulerctl set prefer-mig-split=false` — this should prefer larger contiguous allocations while we stabilize.

infra-aisha: repack finished at 6329990026. freed 6 full GPUs from consolidation, but autoscaler still blocked by cloud quota.

cloud-ops-bot: Quota increase requested to GCP: increase GPUs by 20 in region us-west1 — ticket GCP-9987 submitted. Response time nominal 15-45m.

oncall-2: takeover ack. Monitoring queue and scale metrics, will watch for autoscaler success and customer errors.

sre-elena: summary so far: immediate mitigations freed 6 GPUs via repack and throttling. Root cause likely a conjunction: (a) aggressive MIG split policy producing many small slices, (b) packing/placement heuristics that didn't coalesce, (c) hard cloud GPU quota hit.

sre-elena: action items post-incident: add quota-usage alerting, adjust autoscaler retry/backoff for quota errors, scheduled weekly repack window, review default MIG sizing recommendations for common workloads.

product-liz: I'll draft customer note for Acme/BetaApp and coordinate with CSMs.

support-jamal: customers updated. Monitoring shows 5xxs decreasing but still elevated for 10m.

sre-elena: marking current state: mitigating — traffic partially restored, queued requests draining slowly. Will remain in incident mode until autoscaler can provision or quota bump confirmed. :white_check_mark:
